latin: Sola materia sufficit ad id saluandum, cuius gratia Aristoteles et alii philosophi priuationem inter principia naturalia posuerunt.
translation: Matter alone suffices to account for that for whose sake Aristotle and other philosophers posited privation among the natural principles.
